name: HM02
description: Flies up on the first turn, then attacks next turn.

gifts.note: Beat Cynthia. After you drive Team Aqua out of the Weather Institute, head north on Route 119 toward Fortree City. Your rival Cynthia challenges you on the way; win and she gives you HM Fly. The battle can't be avoided and she waits for a rematch if you lose, so it can't be missed.
